content.text:
Update hackathon.md in this repo. Make exactly these two edits, then commit.

1. In the "## Demo" section, replace the first sentence "Not recorded yet." so the section reads:

Recorded on 2026-10-12. Two cuts, both 1920x1080 with burned-in subtitles and an .srt file:

- Short cut, 1:26, with an ElevenLabs voiceover: problem, architecture, implementation, runtime with the 503 recovery, reasoning (nova-micro rejected, nova-lite shipped), result (trace B minus trace A: 2,223 fewer tokens, intent labels match on 6 of 6 tickets), Entire graph output and the cfo.ai input.
- Full cut, 2:50, the same chapters in more detail, without voice.

Both are built from screenshots of the production build and the numbers in `evidence/`. The video files are not in the repo.

Local run: `npm install`, put `NEATLOGS_API_KEY` and `ADMIN_PASSWORD` in `.env.local`, `npm run build && npm start`, then `POST /api/runs` with `{"mode":"investigate"}` and poll `GET /api/runs/:id`.

2. In the line starting "Outstanding:", remove "the demo video, " so it reads: "Outstanding: an Entire checkpoint, the cfo.ai plan, `#neatHack` posts, and the quote post."

Change nothing else. Then run: git add hackathon.md && git commit -m "Log the recorded demo video in the build log". Do not push.

content.text:
I made both edits to `hackathon.md` and committed them on `docs/demo-video` as `0fa4a2f` ("Log the recorded demo video in the build log"). The working tree is clean, and I didn't push.

- **Demo section:** "Not recorded yet." is replaced with the recording date, the two cuts and the note that the video files aren't in the repo. The local-run instructions are unchanged and now sit in their own paragraph.
- **Outstanding line:** it now reads "Outstanding: an Entire checkpoint, the cfo.ai plan, `#neatHack` posts, and the quote post."

`AGENTS.md` says every change should add a line to `docs/LOGS.md` ending with `~aditya`, `~dhirender` or `~agent`. I skipped that because you asked me to change nothing else. I also used your commit message exactly as written, so it has no Co-Authored-By line. I can add either one in a follow-up commit if you want.
